records.title: Seven Hundred Jacks, One Church
asr_before_after: The engineering solution was remarkable, but rebuilding placed real burdens on the people who remained.
One of the most striking challenges was St. Patrick's Church, the building weighed an estimated 3000 tons.

According to the Galveston and Texas History Centre, workers used 700 jacks to raise it 5 feet, a heavy masonry church, moved upward not by a single enormous machine, but by the patient coordination of many smaller lifts.
